items.content:

replied.post_title: Need Help With Lovense Setup & Tip Reactions
replied.reply_text: Happy to help! 😊 For connecting Lovense toys to cam sites, the easiest way is through the Cam Extension — it automatically detects your toy and syncs tip reactions on platforms like Chaturbate, Stripchat, and others. Just install it, link your Lovense account, and it handles everything. For tip reactions, you can set custom vibration patterns at different token levels (e.g., 10 tokens = short buzz, 50 tokens = stronger pattern). Viewers really love feeling in control! For more interactivity, try setting a tip menu, activating the feel feature, and using VibeMate for random-level surprises. Cam101's own tutorials in the Cam Extension section are super helpful too. Good luck with your streams! 🎉
